pageDescription: Track extras, reductions, and approvals that affect contract value.

panel.title: Changes & extras
panel.description: Pending requests stay separate from the current contract value until approved.

empty.title: No change requests yet
empty.description: Record extras and reductions here so nothing is approved or billed by accident.

summary.title: Contract value
summary.entryBaselineHint: Approved changes apply to the managed opening basis — not the full real-world original.
summary.potentialHint: Current value plus pending — not part of the contract until approved.

form.createDescription: Describe the extra or reduction. Pricing can come later.
form.title: Title
form.requestedAmountHint: Optional until you price a quote version.
form.projectHint: Choose the project this change applies to.

quote.pageDescription: Price a change inside an existing project. This is not a pre-project estimate, not a sales quote, and not billing. Issued versions cannot be edited.

approve.pageDescription: Approval creates an approved change order and updates current contract value.
approve.noAmount: Add a price or requested amount before approval.
approve.approverNameHint: Client contact or internal approver — optional.
approve.noPermission: You can view this request but approving requires the approve permission.

reverse.description: The original change order stays in the history. Current contract value is neutralized by an opposite change order.
reverse.alreadyReversedBody: Reversed by {reference}. The original row remains in history; current contract value is neutralized.
reverse.isReversal: This is a reversing change order and cannot be reversed again.
reverse.noPermission: Reversing a change order requires the approve-changes permission.

errors.notDraft: Only draft change requests can be edited.
errors.cannotPrice: This change request can no longer be priced.
errors.quoteNotDraft: Only draft quote versions can be issued.
errors.quoteImmutable: Issued quote versions are immutable. Create a new version instead.
errors.quoteNotIssued: Approval requires an issued quote version.
errors.noContract: Set an original contract value on the project before approving.
errors.noAmount: Provide a priced quote or requested amount before approval.
errors.referenceConflict: Could not assign a change order reference. Try again.
errors.cannotReverseReversal: A reversing change order cannot be reversed again.
errors.alreadyReversed: This change order has already been reversed.
errors.unsafeBilling: This change order has finalized billing. Issue a credit note or void that billing first.
errors.closedMonth: Cannot reverse a change order into a closed month. Use an open month as the effective date.
